gameRules.mechanic: 左右推力驱动惯性货橇；按住冰爪仅在结霜带产生额外制动。完整货橇进入目标区且速度不超限并连续驻留，才交付当前货物。冲出边界或急刹损伤耗尽货物耐久则失败。
gameRules.intervalAuditScope: Only the complete ordinary corpus is audited per call and segment. Browser and recording evidence retains sparse observations, permanent receipts and explicitly missing intervals.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

ordinaryFrostDelivery.scope: Actual held-key dispatches, original sparse periodic observations and permanent delivery/terminal receipts. Pilot endpoints are retained separately; receipt timestamps do not establish cross-stream exact-state ordering. Key counts include menu navigation. Missing calls and instantaneous events remain explicit; no physics or hidden interval is replayed. Model time/scenario, call sequence, host tick and recording seconds remain distinct. Local durations come only from each observed actual lastStep, never timestamp subtraction. Separate ordinary complete-call evidence owns full interval physics.

controls.scope: Actual controller transport plus a separately declared TV input bridge and ordinary keyboard lifecycle prefixes. No complete normal or negative rounds here; separately reviewed art-gap runs own those observations.

finalEvidence.normalFailureEvidenceScope: Separate normal art-gap runs; not control-only UI or QR

terminalHold.scope: Conservative wall interval from completion of the first retained won-state read to start of the last retained read; every retained states observation in this window has the same terminal model. Sparse observations only.

actualGameplay.scopeNote: Actual software browser held input and sparse Frost observations; permanent receipts do not fill missing calls. Conservative terminal hold uses actual read windows. Two distinct reviewers opened the declared original encoded/UI images. Controller transport and controlled input prefixes remain distinct from separate natural-loss art-gap runs and the complete ordinary audit. No hardware, exact-frame alias, second full decode or reconstructed interval claim.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
